# BelPhO — Belarusian Physics Olympiad

> BelPhO (Белорусская физическая олимпиада) is Belarus's national physics olympiad, preparing school students for IPhO. This site publishes its problem archive (statements, solutions, marking schemes, hints) alongside alumni results and training materials. Primary audience: Russian-speaking, Belarus-based, school-age olympiad students, mostly on mobile.

## Primary content

- [Problem finder](https://belpho.org/problems/): searchable/filterable archive of 859 olympiad problems across four stages — Республиканская (republican final), Городская/3rd stage (city), Сборы (training camps) and IZhO (Zhautykov Olympiad) — spanning multiple decades, each with statement, solution, marking scheme and hints where available.
- [Topics syllabus](https://belpho.org/problems/topics/): the physics taxonomy the problems are organized against.
- [Alumni](https://belpho.org/alumni): Belarusian IPhO team results and profiles since 1995.
- [Library](https://belpho.org/books/): textbooks and problem collections, principally А. И. Слободянюк's «Физика для любознательных».
- [News](https://belpho.org/news/): olympiad announcements and alumni interviews.

## Machine-readable data

- [Sitemap index](https://belpho.org/sitemap.xml)
- [Problem index](https://belpho.org/problems/data/index.v1.json)

## Notes for automated agents

- Problem URLs follow /problems/<stage>/<year>/<slug>/, with /solution/, /marking/, /hints/, /edu/ sub-pages where that content exists for a given problem — a missing sub-page means that material does not exist for that problem, not a broken link.
- Original-language content is Russian; do not machine-translate problem statements when quoting them, they are transcribed verbatim from the official olympiad PDFs.
